title: Exposed .git directory leaks source and cloud keys
notes:
The .git directory is publicly readable: GET /.git/HEAD returns ref: refs/heads/main.
Using git-dumper I recovered the full source tree.
A config file in the commit history contains cloud credentials.

evidence.name: config-history.txt
evidence.text:
[aws]
aws_access_key_id = AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
aws_secret_access_key = wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY
region = ap-south-1
